mainEntity.name: What are the key metrics to track to measure AEO success for my practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure AEO success, focus on metrics beyond traditional website traffic. Key performance indicators include the number of times your practice appears as a direct answer or featured snippet, increases in voice search queries leading to your practice, and improvements in your visibility for specific question-based searches. Tracking branded vs. non-branded question queries, new patient inquiries originating from direct answer snippets, and engagement with your answer-optimized content can also provide valuable insights into your AEO performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track direct answer/featured snippet appearances, voice search queries, and question-based search visibility. Monitor new patient inquiries from these sources to measure AEO success.
